# Fixture provenance

Every image in this directory is either generated by this repository or
released into the public domain (CC0). No scraped artwork, ever.

| File | Source | License |
|---|---|---|
| `ball_hueshift.png`, `ball_4x.png`, `ball_selout.png`, `black_hat.png`, `mushroom_shared.png`, `slime_noline.png` | Generated by `scripts/make_fixtures.py` | Part of this repo (MIT) |
| `kenney_wizard.png` (tile_0084), `kenney_knight.png` (tile_0097), `kenney_rogue.png` (tile_0100), `kenney_ghost.png` (tile_0121) | [Kenney, *Tiny Dungeon* 1.0](https://kenney.nl/assets/tiny-dungeon), `Tiles/` folder, unmodified | CC0 1.0: [`licenses/kenney-tiny-dungeon-License.txt`](licenses/kenney-tiny-dungeon-License.txt) |

`expected.json` holds the ground truth. For generated sprites it is exact (the
generator knows every ramp); for the Kenney sprites only the unambiguous facts
are pinned (outline colour and thickness, bases of clearly separate materials).
